opening.argument: The offer presents an AI trading bot and ties Bitcoin funding to recurring weekday income, while citing a monthly gain associated with the trading program. Participation requires at least $100 in Bitcoin and funding within seven days, creating a defined payment deadline and a stated consequence of removal for those who do not comply. The opportunity also adds residual earnings through direct recruitment: qualification requires one referral on each side, and the materials link increasing weekly income to team growth. This combination of trading-based earnings, required funding, and a two-sided referral structure supports the claimed concern, even though the materials acknowledge that trading results are not guaranteed and do not establish completed payments, losses, or the accuracy of the trading claims.
